title: Ricotta and Spinach Lasagne
subtitle: with a creamy bechamel top
description: A vegetarian lasagne layered with a garlicky spinach and ricotta filling and topped with bechamel. Bake until lightly browned on top.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and fry the halved garlic until golden. Pour the oil into a small bowl, leaving the garlic in the pan.
Add the spinach to the pan, reduce the heat and cook for 3 minutes to evaporate the liquid. Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg and take off the heat. Stir in the ricotta and egg.
Cook the lasagne sheets in boiling salted water for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened. Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Line a greased 20x30 cm baking dish with a layer of lasagne sheets and spread a third of the spinach mixture over them. Repeat 3 times, finishing with a layer of lasagne sheets.

For the bechamel, melt the butter in a small pot, add the flour and stir until absorbed. Pour in the milk, bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring, until thickened. Season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Pour the bechamel over the lasagne and grate a little Parmesan on top if you like. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes until the top is lightly browned.
